membership.faqTrialQ: Is Trial the same as a Free plan?
membership.faqTrialA: No. There is no Free plan. The standard Trial lasts 7 days and uses the same limits as Pro.
membership.faqVoiceA: No. Monthly speaking seconds reset at the calendar month boundary.
membership.faqPayA: Checkout uses catalog offerings and the methods returned by the commerce API: QR, redirect, or manual confirmation. Complete the order after return.
membership.faqAiQ: Are AI tutor, agent, and live media fully ready?
membership.faqAiA: AI tutor is an Ultra catalog flag and may still be gated. AI agent and assessment remain disabled until they are ready. Do not assume live media is production-ready.
